Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to destroy a Fly app or volume

What happens

Fly.io volume destroy. The call below tries to destroy a Fly app or volume. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Fly.io.

The call

fly volumes destroy --yes

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Keep copies of the volume data outside Fly, for example a scheduled dump to object storage. An app-scoped deploy token (fly tokens create deploy) limits the damage of a misused token to one app, but it does not stop a volume destroy.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule fly-destroy, first stopped in version 0.35.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
